verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs explicitly claim automatic calculation and filing of payroll taxes with correct federal, state, and local agencies at the right time, plus automatic tax calculation/filing worldwide, directly matching the story. Evidence is vendor-sourced only, with no independent/hands-on corroboration of tax filing accuracy or remittance specifics; missing for 10: independent verification of accurate multi-jurisdiction filing/remittance, details on handling agency notices or penalty guarantees.
